'''L'lahsh-marinated nutrient globes''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] made with [[L'lahsh]],<ref name="Menu" /> a beverage distilled from the [[Nectar/Legends|nectar]] of [[t'iil]] blossoms.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|257|l'lahsh}}</ref> The dish was served with [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetables]] at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] on [[Centaxday/Legends|Centaxdays]] for 8.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] as part of the [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant's]] [[Pantoran Plate Specials|Pantoran Plate]] lunch and diner specials.<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
L'lahsh-marinated nutrient globes were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
